_comment: Privacy levels (privacy tiers), shown at first connect (native modal + web modal) and in Settings > Privacy in both apps (desktop src/gui/pages/privacy.rs; website web/shared/privacy-tiers.js, drawn by web/chat/chat-privacy.js and web/pages/settings-privacy.js). The DEFAULT is maximum privacy. `name`, `tagline` and `description` are KEYS in data/i18n/en.json (both apps refuse a level whose key is missing and fall back to one Private level), so the words are the same in both and translatable. A level is a preset over two real switches: hide_presence (relay privacy_update: never online, no last_seen stored, no join/leave/typing signals) and directory_unlisted (profile privacy JSON: hidden from the public member directory). Every true/false field here is a switch both apps must apply: tests/settings_used_lint.rs fails on one that src/ or web/ does not read (BUG-238, 2026-11-03: a fourth level, Spotlight, carried promote_streaming, which nothing read, and promised to show a live stream to viewers; it was taken out until that is built, see docs/BUGS.md BUG-238). Direct messages are E2EE whatever the level; channel posts are not (BUG-223). The readable-web opt-in (AppConfig.readable_web) is deliberately NOT part of any level: it is off by default and stays off until the person flips it, so a level change never starts the app fetching web pages.
